review_state: C21 assembly/owner identity confirmed; D52-local two-face fit joins C21 lower physical lead to the R4-right solder trace; exact sheet 1 corrects C21/R20 series topology

assembly.observation: C21 is explicitly labelled as a vertical part directly below R20, left of D52 and right of D105; R19 is separately labelled farther below.

owner.observation: Both overlapping July views show the green vertical dipped part between the R20-position red body and D52, matching the C21 assembly footprint. The upper green lead visibly shares F.Cu with the red body lower lead; the coated lower green lead crosses above C92 right strip and lands separately near D52. No legible 24 code or measured capacitor value is available.

r4_endpoint_candidate.limit: The old D13/D105 projections extrapolated several hundred pixels beyond their packages and missed the R4 endpoint horizontally by about 40 px; they are superseded by the nearer D52-local fit. This confirms the C21 lower physical contact at the R4-right B.Cu endpoint but does not alone close the remote D13.5 route or assign the C21 upper/R20 return rail.
r4_endpoint_candidate.next_test: With power off, confirm R4 right at solder (3115,1398) to green C21 lower at solder (2380,1440), then trace that branch to D13.5. Separately test C21 upper to the R20-position lower lead and trace R20 opposite lead to its source return.

D105_local_crosscheck.observation: The closer D105 row improves the projected green-lower-contact vertical match to about 14 px, but leaves roughly 37 px horizontal separation from the R4-route joint (2380,1440). Both fits extrapolate beyond the right edge of D105, so neither proves the same hole.

D52_local_crosscheck.package: marked К555КП14 D52, immediately right of green C21, matching exact .009 assembly label D52
D52_local_crosscheck.fit_limit: The green lower contact is only about 65 front pixels outside D52 near row, and its projection differs from the actual solder crown by about 7 px vertically and 1 px horizontally. Lead bends/crown centres limit drill precision, but the D52-local geometry plus distinctive green lead position supports a same-hole physical match.

decision: The green C21 body is assembly-identified beside D52. D52-local front/solder registration photo-joins its lower physical lead to R4 right at solder (2380,1440), agreeing with the exact .009 C21-from-RESIN branch. Its upper physical lead joins the R20-position lower lead on visible front copper, agreeing with the exact C21/R20 series pair. The remote R20 return and C21 installed value remain open.

source_correction.observation: A filled junction after R4 feeds D13.5 and the upper plate of C21. The lower plate of C21 enters R20=1,5к in series. R20 far lead descends through the lower control-wire bundle without a local ground or A/+5 termination; the final endpoint remains unresolved. The prior model incorrectly connected R20 directly to RESIN/+5 V and C21 directly to ground.

return_trace_review.overview_orientation: rotate 90 degrees counterclockwise for upright drawing
return_trace_review.observation: R20 far lead descends, jogs right around the D50/R29 height, crosses the D50.5/R29 horizontal conductor without a filled junction, then continues separately into the lower sheet-1 wire bundle. The full-sheet overview confirms this is a drawn continuation rather than an isolated lead. Its far endpoint cannot be assigned securely from these parallel crossings; no local ground or A/+5 symbol terminates this branch.
